original.rule: One uniformly selected user turn per shuffled conversation. Preserve full preceding conversation. Filter 32..3072 model-chat tokens. No filler or B-dependent selection.
original.limitation: Filtered English ShareGPT conversation subset. It is not a production arrival trace or an unfiltered population sample.

scope: Explicit tokenizer-prefix length matching from real ShareGPT text. Not natural full-dialogue lengths or Azure requests.
Qwen_prompt_mode: Official chat template, enable_thinking=False, then explicitly selected prefix.
